name: remotive-jobs-mcp
description: Remotive (jobs): search. Every tool maps to a documented endpoint.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Keyless public API. Only limit is documented (no page parameter), so page > 1 repeats the same result set. Terms: link back to the Remotive URL and name Remotive as the source, never re-post the jobs to other job sites, and 'fetch at most ~4 times a day' (the client-side limiter allows one call per 100 s); listings are delayed 24 h. salary is a free-text string, left in raw.
